findings.failure_path: The final +85-byte change restores a gate trigger, so it can change which references a design session loads. Subtracting 85 from the measured margin establishes entry size, not the final loaded-byte median. A newly triggered reference read can exhaust the remaining 127 bytes—the same failure mechanism recorded in §11.11. Applying the earlier passing batch to the landing candidate therefore lacks the retest expressly required at line 775.
findings.smallest_fix: Rerun the strictest implicit Go reservation task against the final 26,994-byte entry and record its loaded-byte median. Until then, explicitly mark the final candidate’s §10.6 verdict pending and retain the pass only for the tested snapshot.
